Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

flipmeta 0.1.1

flipmeta 0.1.0

First public release

  • Added flipmeta() for robust score testing of univariate meta-analytic and meta-regression models fitted with metafor::rma.uni().
  • Added support for the REML, ML, DL, and EE heterogeneity estimators, including models fitted with a fixed value of tau-squared.
  • Added joint analyses of related model specifications. Study identifiers keep sign flips aligned across models when studies are reordered, filtered, or only partially shared between specifications.
  • Added coefficient selection through tested_coeffs and model-level metadata through extra.
  • Added reproducible analyses through user-supplied sign-flip matrices.
  • Added multiplicity adjustment through flipmeta::p.adjust(), including max-T adjustment and adjustments within families defined by by.
  • Added print(), summary(), and plot() methods for single and joined analyses.
  • Added spec_curve() for visualizing joined specification analyses and transf_p() for transforming plotted p-values.
  • Re-exported combine_tests() and combine_contrasts() from flipscores.
  • Added input validation and explicit errors for invalid study identifiers, incompatible flip matrices, unsupported models, and numerically degenerate flip-specific variances.
  • Added deterministic tests of mathematical results, study alignment, multiple-testing adjustments, input validation, and presentation methods.
